logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now() as String {format: "dd-MM-yyyy"}, level: Mule::p('system.log.level') default "INFO", environment: Mule::p('mule.env') default "local", apiName: app.name, flow: flow.name, correlationId: vars.correlationId, httpMethod: attributes.method, message: "Initiating order put request to PAPI" }]

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { order_to_update: payload, method: attributes.method, id:attributes.uriParams.orderId }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { Message: "There isn't orders to update data with id entered", status: "Fail" }

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now() as String {format: "dd-MM-yyyy"}, level: Mule::p('system.log.level') default "INFO", environment: Mule::p('mule.env') default "local", apiName: app.name, flow: flow.name, correlationId: vars.correlationId, httpMethod: vars.saveData.method, details:{ message: payload } }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "userId": vars.saveData.order_to_update.userId, "productName": vars.saveData.order_to_update.productName, "brand": vars.saveData.order_to_update.brand, "price": vars.saveData.order_to_update.price, "quantity": vars.saveData.order_to_update.quantity, "discount": vars.saveData.order_to_update.discount, "orderDate": now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"} }

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "log_type": "SYSTEM_API_ERROR", "API_NAME": app.name, "correlation_id": vars.correlationId, "flow_name": flow.name, httpMethod: attributes.method, "timestamp": now(), "details": { "target_id": attributes.uriParams.id default "UNKNOWN", "error_type": (error.errorType.namespace default "DB") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "UNKNOWN"), "error_description": error.description default "No description available", "message": "Failed to "++ attributes.method ++ " order from PAPI." } }]
